nom: Onekind Radical Repair Retinol Reinveted Serum for Sensitive Skin with Peptides + Squalane

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or drying skin report the serum absorbs quickly and leaves skin soft and quenched, though one found it dried her facial skin out.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers consistently report no reaction, no rash, no increased sun sensitivity, and no irritation or dryness even with regular retinol use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles, smoother and more poreless-looking texture, and fading of scars or dark spots within one to two weeks.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles within one to two weeks, smoother and tighter-looking skin, and a more youthful appearance with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe skin as soft, quenched, plumper, and more hydrated after use; one reviewer, however, says the product dries her facial skin out.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with pink/red-toned pale skin reports the pinkness resolves with twice-daily use and returns if she stops; another with post-surgery red scars saw them fade.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the formula feels like it strengthens rather than stresses the skin barrier, and a physician reviewer reports no redness or flaking despite past irritation from other retinols.
concerns.spots: One reviewer noticed a dark spot on her forehead visibly fade within a week; a physician reviewer reports skin looking more even-toned overall.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports clearer-looking skin within a few days; no reviewer reports new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically addresses oiliness or oil control.

extraits.texte: I like how easy thw product it use but it drys my facial skin out. I believe that this product would be more useful for a young 20-30 year old.

I have been using this serum nightly, following it with the Barrier Balm,for the last 10 days, and my skin has responded amazingly! At my considerable age, wrinkles are just there, but I do see real improvement in the texture of my skin. It is virtually poreless, and looks and feels smooth and fresh. I live in Florida and have had some skin cancer surgery on my face, and thought I would live with the red scars forever, but even they are fading! I don't do rave reviews much, but I'm telling friends to just "try my new skin stuff" these days!

extraits.titre: Review: Radical Repair™ Retinol Reinvented Serum – A Physici
extraits.texte: As a physician who grew up in the South, skincare wasn't exactly something I paid much attention to growing up. For years, I treated it like an afterthought—if I thought about it at all. But with age (and a bit of humility), I've come to take the issue more seriously. About two months ago, I added Radical Repair™ Retinol Reinvented Serum to my nighttime routine, and the results have genuinely surprised me. My skin feels smoother, more even-toned, and noticeably healthier. Even more telling: within the last couple of weeks, two different patients spontaneously commented on how good my skin looked. That's not the kind of compliment a man in his fifties typically hears—especially not in a clinical setting. What I appreciate most is how well the formula balances effectiveness with gentleness. I've avoided retinols before due to irritation or dryness. This one? No redness, no flaking—just steady, visible improvement. It absorbs quickly, layers well, and the airless pump keeps the product clean and easy to use. In short, Radical Repair™ has earned a permanent spot in my regimen. I recommend it to anyone—especially those who think it's "too late" to start taking skincare seriously. It's not.

I first ordered my Radical Repair Retinol Reinvented Serum during the cooler/cold months of the year, in NY. My skin was beginning to dry and I decided to try this product. I couldn't have been happier! The serum was a treat to apply and it absorbed quickly. My face felt so soft, quenched and alive! I have been using this product ever since and I'm truly thankful I've found it. Thank you, OneKind, for making such a wonderful product!

extraits.titre: Huge difference in just one week
extraits.texte: This retinol serum has already transformed my skin in just one week. The wrinkles around my eyes are much less prominent, and my complexion looks brighter. I've also noticed a dark spot on my forehead already noticeably fade. At this price point, this is a must hoard product.
I have very sensitive skin, and this is the first retinol product that has not caused a reaction. I have used it for a week. I have no rash and have not had increased reaction to sun.
My skin looks smoother, clearer and more supple. This serum feels really nice on the skin and doesn't irritate or dry my sensitive skin. Would definitely recommend!
